VertiGo Series Wiki

🔛 Meet VertiGo™ : The World’s First Vertical Laser Engraver for Tumblers, Cups, and More

How does VertiGo’s vertical architecture change the way you think about cylindrical processing?

Traditional rotary systems force you to work around the machine—adjusting fixtures, compensating for uneven contact, and constantly recalibrating for different diameters. VertiGo flips that paradigm. By shifting from a horizontal rotary setup to a vertically controlled motion system, it brings the workpiece, focus, and motion into a more stable, predictable relationship. The result is not just easier setup, but fundamentally more consistent engraving across varying shapes and sizes. Instead of adapting your workflow to the machine, VertiGo adapts to your application—making precision on cylinders feel as straightforward as working on a flat surface.
